description:
As a QA Engineer
  I want to automate the Pet endpoints on the Petstore Swagger API
  So that I can verify the API works correctly for all CRUD operations

elements.name: TC-API-01 - POST /pet - Create a new pet successfully

steps.name: I have a pet payload with name "Bruno" and status "available"
I send a POST request to "/pet"
the response status code should be 200
the response body should contain the pet name "Bruno"
the response body should contain the status "available"

elements.name: TC-API-02 - GET /pet/{id} - Retrieve the created pet and verify it matches POST data

steps.name: I have previously created a pet with name "Bruno" and status "available"
I send a GET request to "/pet/{id}" using the created pet's ID
the response status code should be 200
the response body pet name should match "Bruno"
the response body pet status should match "available"
the response body pet ID should match the one returned by POST

elements.name: TC-API-03 - PUT /pet - Update pet name and status

steps.name: I have previously created a pet with name "Bruno" and status "available"
I send a PUT request to "/pet" with updated name "Bruno Updated" and status "pending"
the response status code should be 200
the response body should contain the pet name "Bruno Updated"
the response body should contain the status "pending"

elements.name: TC-API-04 - DELETE /pet/{id} - Delete pet and verify it no longer exists

steps.name: I have previously created a pet with name "Bruno" and status "available"
I send a DELETE request to "/pet/{id}" using the created pet's ID
the response status code should be 200
I send a GET request to "/pet/{id}" using the created pet's ID
the response status code should be 404

elements.name: TC-API-05 - GET /pet/{id} - Returns 404 for non-existent pet

steps.name: I send a GET request to "/pet/999999999"
the response status code should be 404
the response body should contain the message "Pet not found"

name: Petstore API - Pet CRUD Operations

description:
As a registered user of GameTwist.com
  I want to log in to my account
  So that I can access my games, coins, and profile

elements.name: TC-LOG-01 - Successful login with valid credentials

steps.name: the user is on the GameTwist homepage "https://www.gametwist.com/en/"
a registered account exists with email "test.user@example.com" and password "ValidPass1"
the user clicks on the "Log In" button
the user enters the email "test.user@example.com"
the user enters the password "ValidPass1"
the user clicks the "Log In" button
the user should be redirected to the GameTwist dashboard
the user's username should be visible in the navigation bar
the user's coin balance should be displayed

elements.name: TC-LOG-02 - Login attempt with incorrect password

steps.name: the user is on the GameTwist homepage "https://www.gametwist.com/en/"
a registered account exists with email "test.user@example.com" and password "ValidPass1"
the user clicks on the "Log In" button
the user enters the email "test.user@example.com"
the user enters an incorrect password "WrongPass99"
the user clicks the "Log In" button
an error message should be displayed saying "Invalid email or password"
the user should remain on the login page
the user should NOT be logged in

elements.name: TC-LOG-04 - Account locked after 5 consecutive failed login attempts

steps.name: the user is on the GameTwist homepage "https://www.gametwist.com/en/"
a registered account exists with email "test.user@example.com" and password "ValidPass1"
the user clicks on the "Log In" button

the account should be temporarily locked
an error message should be displayed saying "Your account has been temporarily locked due to too many failed attempts"
the user should be unable to log in even with correct credentials
a lockout notification email should be sent to "test.user@example.com"

elements.name: TC-LOG-05 - Password reset email sent for registered account

steps.name: the user is on the GameTwist homepage "https://www.gametwist.com/en/"
a registered account exists with email "test.user@example.com" and password "ValidPass1"
the user clicks on the "Log In" button
the user clicks the "Forgot Password?" link
the user enters the registered email "test.user@example.com"
the user clicks the "Send Reset Link" button
a success message should be displayed saying "A password reset link has been sent to your email"
a password reset email should arrive in the inbox within 2 minutes
the reset link in the email should be valid and lead to a password reset form

description:
As a new visitor to GameTwist.com
  I want to create an account
  So that I can access the games and features of the platform

elements.name: TC-REG-01 - Successful registration with valid details

steps.name: the user is on the GameTwist homepage "https://www.gametwist.com/en/"
the user clicks on the "Register" button
the user enters a unique valid email address
the user enters a valid username between 3 and 20 characters
the user enters a password that meets complexity requirements
the user enters the same password in the confirm password field
the user selects their date of birth indicating they are over 18
the user accepts the Terms and Conditions
the user clicks the "Complete Registration" button
the user should be redirected to the GameTwist dashboard
a welcome message should be displayed
a confirmation email should be sent to the registered email address

elements.name: TC-REG-02 - Registration with an already registered email

steps.name: the user is on the GameTwist homepage "https://www.gametwist.com/en/"
the user clicks on the "Register" button
a user account already exists with email "existing.user@example.com"
the user enters the email address "existing.user@example.com"
the user fills in all other required fields with valid data
the user clicks the "Complete Registration" button
an error message should be displayed saying "This email address is already registered"
the user should remain on the registration page
